svg.title: Lucent Code Cascade - back - normal-reading vector concept
svg.desc: Code Cascade concept, 160 open-top reference-style 4s. Original L logo, circle, divider bars, brackets and exact brand lettering preserved. Selected colored dot positions become rotating 4-code. Blue, green and orange dominant, existing small accents retained. Transparent scalable vector. No crowns. Favorite preserved; no print requested.
